raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Square domain side length",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Results specifies a square but gives no numerical side length or units. Let the modeled square be [0,L] × [0,L], with y upward.",
      "readings": [
        "L = 1 in nondimensional coordinates",
        "L = 0.1 m",
        "L = 1 m"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the Fig. 2 discussion nor the FEM Methods specifies thickness or a per-unit-depth convention for the square model.",
      "readings": [
        "Per-unit-thickness model",
        "Uniform thickness t = L/100",
        "Uniform thickness t = L/20"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Lower-left roller",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Results says 'bottom left edge' without coordinates or supported length. The prescribed zero vertical displacement is explicit; its spatial extent is not.",
      "readings": [
        "uy = 0 only at the lower-left corner (0,0)",
        "uy = 0 along the first bottom-edge segment: y = 0, 0 ≤ x ≤ L/4",
        "uy = 0 along the lowest left-edge segment: x = 0, 0 ≤ y ≤ L/4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Downward force near the upper-right corner",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Results locates the force at the 'top right edge'; this does not uniquely distinguish the corner from a location along either adjoining boundary.",
      "readings": [
        "At the upper-right corner (L,L)",
        "Centered on the rightmost top-edge segment, at (7L/8,L)",
        "Centered on the uppermost right-edge segment, at (L,7L/8)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial footprint of the downward force",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Fig. 2 setup paragraph says 'a force' but does not specify concentrated loading versus an edge traction, its loaded length, or its profile.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated point force",
        "Uniform downward traction over the last L/4 of the adjoining top or right boundary, with total resultant F",
        "Triangular downward traction over that L/4 segment, increasing toward the corner, with total resultant F"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Downward force resultant",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Results gives the downward direction but no force magnitude. The energy normalization in Eq. (4) does not supply one.",
      "readings": [
        "Total downward force F = 1 N",
        "Total downward force F = 1000 N"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The square model and FEM discussion do not specify plane stress versus plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus Y0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (6) identifies Y0 as a constant but gives no value or units. Its absolute scale cancels from Eq. (4) when the stiffness contrast is held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Y0 = 1 in normalized modulus units, holding ε/Y0 fixed",
        "Y0 = 210 GPa, holding ε/Y0 fixed"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (6) supplies a Young's-modulus interpolation, but no Poisson's ratio is reported for the compliance problems.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant Poisson's ratio ν = 0.25 at all densities",
        "Constant Poisson's ratio ν = 0.30 at all densities"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual void stiffness ε",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (6) calls ε a 'small number' to avoid singularity, without specifying its value relative to Y0.",
      "readings": [
        "ε/Y0 = 10^-3",
        "ε/Y0 = 10^-6",
        "ε/Y0 = 10^-9"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Mechanical displacement element order",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Results fixes the 4 × 4 grid and 25 nodal density variables. Methods specifies bilinear density interpolation and a shared FEM mesh, but not the displacement approximation order.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear Q1 displacement elements on the 16 rectangles",
        "Biquadratic Q2 displacement elements on the same 16 rectangles, retaining the stated 25-node bilinear density field"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Stiffness integration rule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The quadrature weights in Eq. (5) concern volume integration. No rule is given for integrating elastic stiffness with the spatially varying cubic SIMP modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "For Q1 displacement elements, evaluate the stated density and modulus fields using 2 × 2 Gauss integration per rectangle",
        "For Q1 displacement elements, evaluate those fields using 3 × 3 Gauss integration per rectangle"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
